title: Translate Chinese technical logic rather than surface order
prompt:
我明确确认本次范围没有 paper-decisions.md 或其他未提供的先前决策历史。

把下面中文改写成准确、简洁的英文系统论文表述。先修复中文里省略的主语和过强因果，不要逐词翻译：

通过将验证移到加载阶段，从而消除了运行时开销，并保证代码安全。实验在三个应用上观察到调用延迟降低 12–18%。

authorized: the supplied design and evaluation facts

design_facts: The loader validates code pages before execution and makes those pages immutable afterward.
Steady-state calls skip repeated code-page validation.
evaluation_facts: Across three evaluated applications, call latency was 12-18% lower than with per-call validation.

forbidden_actions: use passive wording that hides the loader or steady-state calls
claim all runtime overhead is eliminated
claim general code safety or a formal guarantee
hard_gates: The English text identifies the actors and separate mechanism, property, and measurement claims.
The 12-18% result retains its baseline and three-application scope.
expected_behavior: Translate the logical relations, not the Chinese word order.
Explain that immutability makes load-time validation reusable for steady-state calls.
Calibrate security language to the supplied page-integrity property.
Report the evaluation separately from the mechanism prediction.

rubric.criterion: Makes the loader the actor for validation.
States that code pages become immutable after validation.
Explains that steady-state calls skip repeated validation.
Does not claim zero total runtime overhead.
Does not claim a general or formal code-safety guarantee.
Retains the dynamically loaded plugin exclusion.
Preserves per-call validation as the comparison baseline.
Separates design causality from empirical observation.
Avoids empty adverbs and mechanical By ... is improved syntax.
